from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper found in the collection, along with the titles of other papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the other provided papers that this paper explicitly cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated data from all provided papers."""
    papers: list[Paper]
